new_value: Fixed in rust/lichen-rpl/src/dodag.rs process_dio(). A newer DODAGVersionNumber now supersedes the local one unconditionally (RFC 6550 section 8.2.2.4): candidate_admissible() is evaluated first, adopt_version() runs, and only the individual candidate is rejected when inadmissible. The old gate let a node cling to version N indefinitely when every newer-version advertiser had a temporarily bad rank/link, partitioning it from the migrated network. Security unchanged: an attacker could already force adoption by claiming an admissible rank. The old test invalid_newer_version_dio_preserves_parent_state pinned the defective behavior (kept stale version + parents across a version boundary) and was rewritten as inadmissible_newer_version_still_adopts_and_resets_membership (version advances, membership resets: unjoined/INFINITE/empty). New test admissible_newer_version_dio_restores_connectivity_after_bad_ones covers the partition scenario end-to-end: saturated-cost v1 advertiser adopts v1 then an admissible v1 DIO rejoins at rank 512. Discovered during analysis and filed separately: select_parent admissible() lacks the floor/DAGRank checks of candidate_admissible(). Verified: cargo test -p lichen-rpl --lib 139 passed.
